metadata.sampling_design: Stratified scenario allocation with a declared latent-factor Gaussian copula, shared shocks across alternatives, marginal-preserving inverse transforms, and matched independent/correlation-stress counterfactuals.

decision.title: Privacy-Conscious Marketing Budget Allocation
decision.domain: Business analytics, marketing analytics, causal experimentation, and behavioral decision-making
decision.question: Allocate the annual acquisition budget across strategies while protecting incremental profit, customer value, privacy, and underserved-customer reach.
blocking_reasons: evidence is not labeled for operational use
decision.feasibility_basis: one-sided 95% upper confidence bound on simulated constraint-breach frequency

current-mix.label: Current channel mix
current-mix.description: Maintain broad paid media, affiliates, and organic programs.

performance-ads.label: Performance-ad concentration
performance-ads.description: Concentrate spend on short-run conversion-optimized digital advertising.

causal-personalization.label: Incrementality-based personalization
causal-personalization.description: Target customers with estimated positive incremental treatment effects and maintain randomized holdouts.

balanced-portfolio.label: Balanced experiment portfolio
balanced-portfolio.description: Combine causal targeting, partnerships, referral programs, and protected exploration budgets.

factors.label: Systemic adverse demand and delivery shock
factors.description: A shared latent shock moves outcome distributions across criteria and alternatives in the adverse direction; signs follow each criterion's value direction.

evidence.type: Synthetic experiment summaries and market scenarios
evidence.as_of: Synthetic demonstration; no production as-of date
evidence.causal_claim_status: Incremental-profit inputs are framed as hypothetical randomized-test estimates; no real causal result is claimed.
limitations: Cross-channel interference and competitor response are simplified.
Long-term brand effects are represented by a proxy score.
Customer groups are aggregated and may conceal intersectional effects.
The Gaussian copula and factor loadings are synthetic assumptions; tail dependence may differ in real data and requires domain approval.

decision_notes: A real campaign portfolio should estimate incremental lift using randomized or defensible quasi-experimental designs.
Privacy and manipulation risk require qualitative review in addition to scoring.
